# ZH Plumbers Network

> A worldwide plumber network: find verified, real plumbing businesses by city or GPS location, and request quotes on contact. Run by ZH Plumbing Service (Gujjar Khan / Rawalpindi, Pakistan) since 2016. No booking fees — clients and plumbers agree the rate directly; the network charges plumbers a 10% fee only on jobs it brings.

## For clients
- Find plumbers near you: https://azaan0000.github.io/zh-plumbers/find-plumber.html (works worldwide — GPS or city search)
- Local 24/7 emergency plumbing in Gujjar Khan & Rawalpindi: https://azaan0000.github.io/zh-plumbers/
- Emergency plumber Islamabad: https://azaan0000.github.io/zh-plumbers/emergency-plumber-islamabad.html
- Geyser repair Rawalpindi & Gujjar Khan: https://azaan0000.github.io/zh-plumbers/geyser-repair-rawalpindi.html
- Drain & sewerage cleaning Rawalpindi: https://azaan0000.github.io/zh-plumbers/drain-cleaning-rawalpindi.html

- Languages: English, Urdu, Arabic (in-page switcher)

## Facts
- All plumber listings are real businesses sourced from public directories (OpenStreetMap, public web). No fake data.
- Rates are quoted on contact; the website does not publish fixed prices.
- Site languages: English (default), Urdu, Arabic.
